records.instruction: Open the black laptop slightly rounded at edges carefully using the right arm.
Open the medium laptop with black case carefully using the right arm.
Open the laptop with glossy black display using the left arm.
Open the foldable laptop with one motion.
Lift the laptop with glossy black display's lid fully.
Reach and grab the roller with tapered tips with both arms
Grab the light brown wooden roller on the table.
Grab the roller with tapered ends on the table with arms.
Use both arms to grab the wooden roller.
Use arms to grab the smooth wooden roller.
Grab the silver hammer head and claw and beat the block.
Use the hammer with claw and smooth head to strike the block
Grab the hammer with black handle and beat the block.
Use the right arm to pick up the hammer with claw and smooth head.
Grab the hammer with black handle and hit the block.
Direct the right arm to click the smooth gray base switch
Use the left arm to press the switch with circular black buttons.
Click the smooth black switch with the right arm.
Click the flat square gray switch with the left arm.
Activate the switch at the gray switch with slanted sides
Lift the bottle with red screw cap from the table using the right arm.
Pick up the green bottle carefully using the left arm
Use the left arm to grab the plastic soda bottle head-up.
Pick up the brown bottle using the right arm in an upright position
Grab the green plastic bottle with ridged bottom on the table and raise it.
